text: Optical engineering is an engineering discipline centered on the generation, transmission, regulation, detection and application of light. It integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as physics, electronics, materials science, and computer science. It is a key supporting discipline in modern information industries, intelligent manufacturing, biomedicine, etc. From the basic research of light phenomena to advanced laser technology, optical fiber communication, and the development of AR/VR devices, the applications of optical engineering have permeated every aspect of production and life, and is hailed as the "invisible cornerstone of the information age".
